alt: A bedroom with an arched headboard viewed from the doorway. Five frames show the same bed, bedside tables, bench, and window in different complete material schemes: chocolate velvet headboard with limewashed plaster and dark walnut; oatmeal boucle headboard with warm white walls and pale oak; forest green linen headboard with cream plaster and aged brass; rust corduroy headboard with terracotta limewash and smoked oak; charcoal wool headboard with grey plaster and black timber.
text:
Five rooms, same bed. Material first, then everything listens.

The bed structure stays. What shifts completely is everything else—the walls, the woods, the textiles. Rust corduroy with terracotta plaster. Oatmeal boucle with pale oak. Each palette is a full conversation.

The rust one is where I linger.

#materialsroom #textilesfirst #bedroomdesign #interiorpalette #designobservation
